paper_title: First search for dark photon dark matter with a MADMAX prototype
notes: First physics result from MADMAX dielectric haloscope prototype. Mass range 78.62–83.95 μeV/c². Excludes χ > 2.7×10⁻¹² over full range with peak sensitivity χ > 1.1×10⁻¹³ at 80.57 μeV/c². Improves previous constraints by up to three orders of magnitude. Data-taking run: 16.5 days (11.7 d effective), 9.484×10⁹ spectra. Boost factor β²_max = 640(110) at 19.48 GHz. System noise temperature 240 K (range 120–332 K). Local DM density ρ_χ = 0.3 GeV/cm³ assumed. No significant DP signal observed; largest local excess 4.3σ (consistent with thermal noise, p≈0.21). Systematic uncertainties 9–19% depending on frequency (dominated by boost factor determination 5–18%). Three sapphire disks (ε=9.3, 1 mm thick, 30 cm diameter) + aluminum mirror. K-band horn antenna (19.01–20.30 GHz RF range). Frequency hopping RFI suppression employed. 22 RFI peaks identified and masked. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.95, 3))
